# User API - Quick Reference Guide ## All Available Endpoints ### 1. **GET /api/users** - Get All Users ``` Method: GET Description: Retrieve all active (non-deleted) users Response: List Example: GET /api/users ``` ### 2. **GET /api/users/{userId}** - Get User By ID ``` Method: GET Description: Retrieve specific user by ID Path Parameters: - userId: Long (required) Response: UserResponse Example: GET /api/users/1 ``` ### 3. **GET /api/users/profile** - Get User Profile By Email (Header) ``` Method: GET Description: Retrieve user profile from email in header Headers: - X-User-Email: string (required) Response: UserResponse Example: GET /api/users/profile Header: X-User-Email: john@example.com ``` ### 4. **GET /api/users/me** - Get Current User Profile ``` Method: GET Description: Retrieve current user's profile Headers: - X-User-Email: string (required) Response: UserResponse Example: GET /api/users/me Header: X-User-Email: john@example.com ``` ### 5. **POST /api/users/create-user** - Create New User (Admin Only) ``` Method: POST Description: Create a new user with default password (Admin@123) Request Body: CreateUserByAdminDTO { "email": "newuser@example.com", "fullName": "New User", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "USER" } Response: CreateUserResponse (includes default password) Example: POST /api/users/create-user ``` ### 6. **PUT /api/users/{userId}** - Update User Profile ⭐ NEW ``` Method: PUT Description: Update user profile (fullName, phone, role only) Email cannot be changed here Path Parameters: - userId: Long (required) Request Body: UpdateUserProfileDTO { "fullName": "Updated Name", // Optional "phone": "+84987654321", // Optional "role": "ADMIN" // Optional } Response: UserResponse Example: PUT /api/users/1 Body: { "fullName": "John Doe", "phone": "+84987654321" } ``` ### 7. **PUT /api/users/{userId}/status** - Update Active Status ``` Method: PUT Description: Enable/disable user account Path Parameters: - userId: Long (required) Query Parameters: - isActive: boolean (required) Response: String (success message) Example: PUT /api/users/1/status?isActive=true PUT /api/users/1/status?isActive=false ``` ### 8. **DELETE /api/users/{userId}** - Delete User (Soft Delete) ``` Method: DELETE Description: Soft delete user (marks as deleted, doesn't remove from DB) Path Parameters: - userId: Long (required) Response: String (success message) Example: DELETE /api/users/1 ``` ### 9. **GET /api/users/search** - Search & Filter Users ⭐ ``` Method: GET Description: Dynamic search, filter, sort with pagination Query Parameters (ALL OPTIONAL): - fullName: Tìm kiếm tên (case-insensitive, LIKE) - email: Tìm kiếm email (case-insensitive, LIKE) - phone: Tìm kiếm phone (exact match) - role: Lọc theo role (ADMIN, USER, OWNER, STAFF, etc.) - isActive: Lọc theo trạng thái (true/false) - pageNumber: Trang (default: 0) - pageSize: Số record/trang (default: 10) - sortBy: Sắp xếp theo field (default: id) - sortOrder: ASC hoặc DESC (default: ASC) Response: Page Examples: - GET /api/users/search?fullName=John - GET /api/users/search?role=ADMIN&isActive=true - GET /api/users/search?email=sky&pageSize=20 - GET /api/users/search?fullName=John&role=ADMIN&pageNumber=0&pageSize=10&sortBy=id&sortOrder=DESC ``` ### 10. **GET /api/users/contact-info** - Get Contact Information ``` Method: GET Description: Retrieve contact info (name, email, phone) for all users Response: List> [ { "fullName": "Alex Turner", "email": "alex@example.com", "phone": "+84987654321" }, ... ] Example: GET /api/users/contact-info ``` --- ## Request/Response Models ### **UserResponse** ```json { "id": 1, "email": "user@example.com", "fullName": "John Doe", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN", "lastLoginAt": "2024-05-12T10:30:00" } ``` ### **CreateUserByAdminDTO** ```json { "email": "newuser@example.com", "fullName": "New User Name", "phone": "+84912345678", "role": "USER" } ``` ### **UpdateUserProfileDTO** ⭐ NEW ```json { "fullName": "Updated Name", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN" } ``` ### **UserSearchFilterDTO** (Internal) ```json { "fullName": "John", "email": "sky", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN", "isActive": true, "pageNumber": 0, "pageSize": 10, "sortBy": "id", "sortOrder": "ASC" } ``` --- ## Most Used Endpoints | Use Case | Endpoint | Method | |----------|----------|--------| | Get all users | /api/users | GET | | Get specific user | /api/users/{userId} | GET | | Create new user | /api/users/create-user | POST | | **Update user profile** ⭐ | **/api/users/{userId}** | **PUT** | | Update active status | /api/users/{userId}/status | PUT | | Delete user | /api/users/{userId} | DELETE | | Search & filter users | /api/users/search | GET | | Get contact info | /api/users/contact-info | GET | --- ## Update User Profile - The NEW Endpoint **Endpoint:** `PUT /api/users/{userId}` **What can be updated:** - ✅ fullName - ✅ phone - ✅ role **What CANNOT be updated:** - ❌ email (use separate endpoint) - ❌ password (use separate endpoint) - ❌ active status (use `/api/users/{userId}/status`) - ❌ deleted status (use DELETE) **Example Request:** ```bash curl -X PUT http://localhost:8080/api/users/1 \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "fullName": "John Doe", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN" }' ``` **Example Response (200 OK):** ```json { "id": 1, "email": "john@example.com", "fullName": "John Doe", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN", "lastLoginAt": "2024-05-12T10:30:00" } ``` --- ## JavaScript Examples ### Fetch API - Update User Profile ```javascript async function updateUserProfile(userId, updates) { const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ fullName: updates.fullName, phone: updates.phone, role: updates.role }) }); return response.json(); } // Usage const updatedUser = await updateUserProfile(1, { fullName: 'John Doe', phone: '+84987654321', role: 'ADMIN' }); ``` ### Axios - Search Users ```javascript import axios from 'axios'; async function searchUsers(filters) { const response = await axios.get('/api/users/search', { params: { fullName: filters.fullName, email: filters.email, phone: filters.phone, role: filters.role, isActive: filters.isActive, pageNumber: filters.pageNumber || 0, pageSize: filters.pageSize || 10, sortBy: filters.sortBy || 'id', sortOrder: filters.sortOrder || 'ASC' } }); return response.data; } // Usage const results = await searchUsers({ fullName: 'John', role: 'ADMIN', pageSize: 20 }); ``` ### React Hook - Complete User Management ```javascript import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; function UserManagement() { const [users, setUsers] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); // Update user profile const handleUpdateUser = async (userId, updates) => { try { const response = await fetch(`/api/users/${userId}`, { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(updates) }); if (response.ok) { const updatedUser = await response.json(); setUsers(users.map(u => u.id === userId ? updatedUser : u)); alert('User updated successfully!'); } else { alert('Failed to update user'); } } catch (error) { console.error('Update error:', error); } }; // Search users const handleSearch = async (searchParams) => { setLoading(true); try { const query = new URLSearchParams(searchParams); const response = await fetch(`/api/users/search?${query}`); const data = await response.json(); setUsers(data.content); } catch (error) { console.error('Search error:', error); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; return (
{/* UI components */}
); } ``` --- ## Status Code Reference | Code | Meaning | |------|---------| | 200 | Success | | 201 | Created | | 204 | No Content | | 400 | Bad Request (invalid data) | | 401 | Unauthorized (auth failed) | | 404 | Not Found (resource doesn't exist) | | 500 | Server Error | --- ## Important Notes 1. **Email cannot be changed** through updateUserProfile endpoint 2. **Active status** should be updated via `/api/users/{userId}/status` endpoint 3. **Password** should be updated via dedicated password change endpoint 4. **Search** parameters are all optional - can be combined freely 5. **Pagination** starts at page 0 (0-indexed) 6. **Soft Delete** - users are marked as deleted, not removed from database --- **All endpoints are ready to use! **

# Implementation Summary - User Search, Filter & Sort with JpaSpecificationExecutor
## ✅ Hoàn thành các tính năng
### 1. **Tìm kiếm theo tên** (Search by Full Name) - Case-insensitive, partial matching - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?fullName=John`
### 2. **Tìm kiếm theo email** (Search by Email) - Case-insensitive, partial matching - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?email=example.com`
### 3. **Tìm kiếm theo số điện thoại** (Search by Phone) - Exact matching - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?phone=%2B84987654321`
### 4. **Lọc theo role** (Filter by Role) - Support tất cả UserRole enum values - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?role=ADMIN`
### 5. **Sắp xếp theo ID** (Sort by ID) - ASC/DESC order support - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?sortBy=id&sortOrder=DESC`
### 6. **Lấy thông tin liên hệ** (Contact Information) - Returns name, email, phone - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/contact-info`
### 7. **Phân trang** (Pagination) - Page number and size - Endpoint: `GET /api/users/search?pageNumber=0&pageSize=20`
---
## Files Created/Modified
### **New Files Created:**
1. **UserSearchFilterDTO.java** - Path: `common-lib/src/main/java/com/example/payload/dto/UserSearchFilterDTO.java` - Chứa tất cả các filter parameters
2. **UserSpecification.java** - Path: `user-service/src/main/java/com/example/repository/specification/UserSpecification.java` - Xây dựng các Specification động sử dụng JPA Criteria API
3. **SEARCH_FILTER_DOCUMENTATION.md** - Path: `user-service/SEARCH_FILTER_DOCUMENTATION.md` - Tài liệu chi tiết về triển khai
4. **FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md** - Path: `user-service/FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md` - Hướng dẫn tích hợp với các frontend framework
### **Files Modified:**
1. **UserRepository.java** - Added: `extends JpaSpecificationExecutor<Users>`
2. **UserService.java** - Added: `searchAndFilterUsers(UserSearchFilterDTO)` - Added: `getUsersContactInfo()`
3. **UserServiceImpl.java** - Implemented: `searchAndFilterUsers()` method - Implemented: `getUsersContactInfo()` method - Implemented: `getUsersByFullName()`, `getUsersByEmail()`, `getUsersByPhone()`
4. **UserController.java** - Added: `/search` endpoint with comprehensive query parameters - Added: `/contact-info` endpoint
---
## Technology Stack
- **Framework:** Spring Boot - **JPA:** Spring Data JPA - **Query Builder:** JPA Specifications & Criteria API - **Pagination:** Spring Data Page API - **Mapping:** ModelMapper
---
## API Endpoints
### 1. Search & Filter API ``` GET /api/users/search ```
**Query Parameters:** - `fullName` (optional): String - Tìm kiếm tên - `email` (optional): String - Tìm kiếm email - `phone` (optional): String - Tìm kiếm phone - `role` (optional): String - Lọc role - `isActive` (optional): Boolean - Lọc trạng thái - `pageNumber` (optional, default=0): Integer - Trang - `pageSize` (optional, default=10): Integer - Số record - `sortBy` (optional, default=id): String - Trường sắp xếp - `sortOrder` (optional, default=ASC): String - ASC/DESC
**Example:** ``` GET /api/users/search?fullName=John&role=ADMIN&isActive=true&pageSize=20&sortBy=fullName&sortOrder=ASC ```
### 2. Contact Information API ``` GET /api/users/contact-info ```
**Returns:** Array of contact information (name, email, phone)
---
## Tính năng chính
✅ **Dynamic Query Building** - Xây dựng query tại runtime ✅ **Multiple Search Fields** - Tìm kiếm trên nhiều field ✅ **Flexible Filtering** - Lọc theo nhiều tiêu chí ✅ **Sorting Support** - Sắp xếp theo bất kỳ field ✅ **Pagination** - Hỗ trợ phân trang đầy đủ ✅ **Case Insensitive** - Tìm kiếm không phân biệt hoa thường ✅ **Type Safe** - Sử dụng Criteria API ✅ **Reusable Specifications** - Có thể tái sử dụng
---
## SQL Query Example
Khi frontend gửi request: ``` GET /api/users/search?fullName=John&role=ADMIN&isActive=true&sortBy=id&sortOrder=ASC ```
Backend tạo ra SQL: ```sql SELECT u FROM Users u WHERE u.deleted = false AND LOWER(u.fullName) LIKE '%john%' AND u.role = 'ADMIN' AND u.active = true ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0 ```
---
## Frontend Integration Example
### JavaScript ```javascript // Simple call const response = await fetch( '/api/users/search?fullName=John&role=ADMIN&pageSize=20' ); const data = await response.json(); console.log(data.content); // Array of users ```
### React ```javascript const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
const handleSearch = async (filters) => { const params = new URLSearchParams(filters); const response = await fetch(`/api/users/search?${params}`); const data = await response.json(); setUsers(data.content); }; ```
### Vue 3 ```javascript const performSearch = async () => { const query = new URLSearchParams(filters); const response = await fetch(`/api/users/search?${query}`); const data = await response.json(); users.value = data.content; }; ```
---
## Response Structure
```json { "content": [ { "id": 1, "email": "user@example.com", "fullName": "User Name", "phone": "+84987654321", "role": "ADMIN", "lastLoginAt": "2024-05-12T10:30:00" } ], "pageable": {...}, "sort": {...}, "totalElements": 100, "totalPages": 10, "number": 0, "size": 10, "numberOfElements": 10, "first": true, "last": false, "empty": false } ```
---
## Frontend UI Mapping (Từ hình ảnh)
| Frontend Field | API Parameter | Loại | |---|---|---| | SEARCH NAME | `fullName` | Text Input | | SEARCH EMAIL | `email` | Text Input | | SEARCH PHONE | `phone` | Text Input | | FILTER ROLE | `role` | Dropdown | | USER PROFILE | Response `fullName` + `id` | Display | | CONTACT DETAILS | `email` + `phone` | Display | | DESIGNATION | `role` | Display | | STATUS | `active` (chuyển thành SUSPENDED/ACTIVE) | Display |
---
## Best Practices Implemented
1. ✅ **Soft Delete** - Luôn lọc `deleted=false` 2. ✅ **Pagination** - Tránh load quá nhiều data 3. ✅ **Sorting** - Tùy chọn sắp xếp linh hoạt 4. ✅ **Type Safety** - Sử dụng Specification Pattern 5. ✅ **Reusable** - Có thể áp dụng cho entities khác 6. ✅ **Performance** - Tối ưu hóa query
---
## Testing Examples
### Test 1: Search by Name ``` GET /api/users/search?fullName=john Expected: Return all users with "john" in fullName (case-insensitive) ```
### Test 2: Filter by Role ``` GET /api/users/search?role=ADMIN Expected: Return all ADMIN users ```
### Test 3: Complex Query ``` GET /api/users/search?fullName=john&role=ADMIN&isActive=true&pageSize=20 Expected: Return active ADMIN users with "john" in name, 20 per page ```
### Test 4: Sorting ``` GET /api/users/search?sortBy=fullName&sortOrder=DESC Expected: Return users sorted by name descending ```
### Test 5: Contact Info ``` GET /api/users/contact-info Expected: Return array of {fullName, email, phone} ```
---
## Documentation Created
- ✅ `SEARCH_FILTER_DOCUMENTATION.md` - Tài liệu chi tiết - ✅ `FRONTEND_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md` - Hướng dẫn tích hợp frontend - ✅ `IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md` - File này
---
## Bonus Features
1. **Advanced Pagination** - Hỗ trợ đầy đủ Page API 2. **Flexible Sorting** - Sort by any field 3. **Combined Filters** - Kết hợp nhiều criteria 4. **Type Safe Queries** - Không lỗi khi compile 5. **Reusable Pattern** - Có thể áp dụng cho entities khác
---
## Support Points
### Nếu muốn thêm tính năng mới:
1. **Thêm filter khác** - Cập nhật `UserSpecification.buildUserSpecification()` 2. **Thêm endpoint mới** - Thêm method mới trong `UserService` + `UserServiceImpl` 3. **Thêm field search** - Thêm parameter vào `UserSearchFilterDTO`
---
## ✨ Conclusion
Hệ thống search, filter và sort đã được triển khai hoàn chỉnh sử dụng **JpaSpecificationExecutor**, cho phép frontend tương tác dễ dàng với API và hiển thị giao diện như trong hình ảnh đã cung cấp.
**Sẵn sàng để triển khai! **
